query: For the paper "TexTrolls: Identifying Russian Trolls on Twitter from a Textual Perspective" (arXiv: 1910.01340), answer this question: What type of model were the features used in?

drafts: The features were used in classification models: the authors tested several classifiers, and Logistic Regression showed the best F1macro value (with default parameter values kept) [21].

requirements.answer_quote: The features were used in classification models: the authors tested several classifiers, and Logistic Regression showed the best F1macro value (with default parameter values kept) [21].
requirements.reason: 答案明确指出特征被用于分类器模型，并具体说明作者测试了多个分类器，其中Logistic Regression表现最佳且保留默认参数值，与原文第7页实验设置部分完全一致，引用[21]直接支持该表述。

citations.quote: We tested several classiﬁers and Logistic Regression showed the best F1macro value. We kept the default parameters values.

cited_sources.text: 5 Experiments and Analysis 5.1 Experimental Setup We report precision, recall and F1 score. Given the substantial class imbalance in the dataset, we use the macro weighted version of the F1 metric. We tested several classiﬁers and Logistic Regression showed the best F1macro value. We kept the default parameters values.
